items.evidence: createCourse now takes bonusAvailable only from the authored level definition; runtime-flow.test.ts checks every catalog level with odd and even seeds and verifies bonus finish options.
items.acceptance: Bonus availability and the generated BONUS finish option are determined only by the level definition; ordinary and safe gates remain distinct; same level is stable across odd/even seeds and reloads.
items.remainingGap: Natural input did not verify entry into the BONUS branch; the browser report records this as NOT_RUN.

items.evidence: Terminal simulation flip is inert; explicit retry copy/buttons are rendered; terminal actions use one-shot availability checks; browser failure/retry passed for both viewports and ordinary completion/next/reload passed at 390x844.
items.acceptance: Failure and ordinary completion show an explicit retry button; next level is shown only when available; blank scene input never restarts; replay starts a clean ready state and a completion record is written once per completed run.
items.remainingGap: 1100x720 ordinary win→next→reload is NOT_RUN because both predeclared fixed schedules ended in failure.

items.evidence: RuntimeLifecycle tests cover pause, input release, wall-time reset, Continue-only resume, BFCache versus real teardown; browser synthetic visibility/blur/pagehide checks passed in both viewports.
items.acceptance: Background/blur pauses active simulation, resets held input and frame time, BFCache return reuses a live renderer, resume requires a visible Continue control without an extra flip, and listeners/animation loops are not duplicated.
items.remainingGap: Browser lifecycle evidence uses synthetic events; actual OS/browser backgrounding and BFCache navigation remain unverified.

items.evidence: LevelProgressStore guards unavailable, read-throwing, corrupt, and write-throwing storage; scoped session fallback retains the latest unlock and exposes a non-blocking warning.
items.acceptance: Corrupt or unavailable storage falls back to session memory with no accidental unlocks; gameplay and unlocked-level selection continue; failed writes retain in-memory progress and show a non-blocking warning.
items.remainingGap: Storage failure branches are logic-tested; no browser fixture replaces window.localStorage in this natural-input run.
